newsitem.title: USA: Defense Dept accepts monthly tin bids for $1.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Defense Dept accepts monthly tin bids for $1.1 mln.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said Thursday it accepted bids from RMT Metals and Cambridge Street Metal to buy U.S. tin valued at $1.16 million.
RMT Metals of New York agreed to buy 200 tonnes at a unit price of $2.51 and Cambridge Street Metal of Allston, Mass. agreed to buy 10 tonnes at a unit price of $2.50, the agency said.
The Defense Department said bids for the next monthly tin offering are due on August 6.
